SELECT

  , CAST(total_revenue AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(total_subscribers, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ltv
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(subq_10.subscriber__country, subq_20.subscriber__country) AS subscriber__country
    , MAX(subq_10.total_revenue) AS total_revenue
    , MAX(subq_20.total_subscribers) AS total_subscribers
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sma_10005_cte.country AS subscriber__country
      , SUM(subq_2.__total_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM (
      SELECT
        subscriber_id AS subscriber
        , case when status = 'succeeded' then amount_usd else 0 end AS __total_revenue
      FROM "streaming_analytics"."marts"."fct_payments" sem_payments_src_10000
      WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', payment_date) BETWEEN '{start_date}' AND '{end_date}'
    ) subq_2
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      sma_10005_cte
    ON
      subq_2.subscriber = sma_10005_cte.subscriber
    GROUP BY
      sma_10005_cte.country
  ) subq_10
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT
      sma_10005_cte.country AS subscriber__country
      , COUNT(DISTINCT subq_13.__total_subscribers) AS total_subscribers
    FROM (
      SELECT
        subscriber_id AS subscriber
        , case when is_active = true then subscriber_id end AS __total_subscribers
      FROM "streaming_analytics"."marts"."fct_mrr_monthly" sem_mrr_src_10000

      sma_10005_cte
    ON
      subq_13.subscriber = sma_10005_cte.subscriber
    GROUP BY
      sma_10005_cte.country
  ) subq_20
  ON
    subq_10.subscriber__country = subq_20.subscriber__country
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(subq_10.subscriber__country, subq_20.subscriber__country)
) subq_21

  , 1 - churn_rate AS retention_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    subscription__plan_type
    , CAST(monthly_churned_subscribers AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(monthly_subscriber_base, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS churn_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      subscription__plan_type
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_churned_subscribers) AS monthly_churned_subscribers
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_subscriber_base) AS monthly_subscriber_base
    FROM (
      SELECT
